notes.title: Quality of Life Improvements - 1.4.19
notes.content:
Hi folks, 

Here are some of the enhancements we've been working on: 

[h3]Character Upgrade Additions[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/73fe1f7cfb123fef8726a0afbb0525e399414920.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Reforging[/b]: A new upgrade that enhances how you use upgrade forges scattered throughout the worlds.
[*] Starter rune max upgrade capacity increased to 2.
[*] Reduced resonant crystal cost of starter rune-related upgrades (if you've purchased them, some crystals will be refunded).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/e0ea9d530529ac9b658fabc9ccdd41732a6687c5.gif[/img][/list][i]Tip: Resonant crystals can be earned by unlocking items or world shortcuts. You can toggle upgrades on/off anytime in exchange for run XP.[/i]

[h3]Dynamic control scheme detection[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/3501cfb09a6b2d08b4fb0fef92c625b31b315d5e.png[/img]
The game now automatically detects if you're using gamepad/mouse control schemes. Swapping every time a button is clicked (instead of prompting you). You can toggle this on/off in the controls menu.

[h3]Localization Improvements[/h3]
We've continued to improve localization across menus and gameplay elements.

[h3]Other quality of life changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] New startup loading screen.
[*] User interface improvements. E.g., World and level number shown in the HUD instead of level/maxLevel. Visual fixes to unlock-related menus.
[*] Weapons/Gadgets/Spells can only be reforged 3 times by default (though you can upgrade this limit), to encourage swapping between different equipment.
[/list]

As always, your feedback is most welcome!

Have fun!

notes.title: Update Set 1.4 - Trading Cards, New Weapons, perks and much more..
notes.content:
[i]Greetings, challengers!

Here's some of the features we've been working on in the last couple of months[/i]

[h2]New Weapons[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/2550aed21fd871632885c9e529faa0e9fddfd8d4.png[/img]


[h3]Whip it good![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/10a35314613e663022b667c3ffb9d51dbdc0e176.gif[/img]
Whips can reach behind, above, or in front of you. It's all in the timing and your wrist!

[h3]Steel hatchet[/h3]
With a special spinning ability:
[img]https://media4.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExYzI4d2s3MW1lcmcwNnBpeXAxZW1yejh1ZmxpZGUydW9jNXZ6OG4xZSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/ftWePRvbh7JShawAYg/giphy.gif[/img]
[h3]New Enemy: Skeletal defender[/h3]
Not all skeletal warriors are fragile. These guards are heavily clad, immune to most frontal attacks and stunning from jumping off their heads, thus requiring a bit more careful positioning to hit effectively.

[h2]Community Items[/h2]
[h3]Trading Cards[/h3]
Six new trading cards and five badges are now available! If you've purchased the game directly through Steam, free cards should start dropping for each hour of gameplay (up to 3).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/2e6f8489d11a12be6a4d3194687e0504d6422eb0.png[/img]

[h3]Emojis and character backgrounds[/h3]
We’ve also added a collection of new emojis and three themed profile backgrounds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/caf627a2c134b2118da91aecb15cc58795a4bb64.png[/img]

[h2]Quality of life improvements[/h2]

[h3]New Spell modifier: Recharge[/h3]
It allows you to freely refill the last spell charge used after a short cooldown and can be applied at upgrade anvils (Note: It does not apply to time manipulation or life drain abilities).
Thus providing an additional way to replenish spells next to exploring for mana stars. 


[h3]Tackle rework:[/h3] Increased damage and stunning aspect of grabbing and throwing opponents at each other. We've also added a [b]new rune[/b] that allows you to pick up and throw opponents almost anywhere.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/733830eacade004ca2bdbfc314cb99b04ce2745f.png[/img]
[b]Tip:[/b] You can grab and throw most opponents while they're stunned or unaware of you. This works without any perks equipped.



[h3]🎼 Epic New Music for Arena Challenges[/h3]
Composed by Mat Dwyer

[h3]Hard Mode Refinements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Most bosses now have faster, more aggressive patterns.
Note: For one specific boss, you may need to have completed the first area before the new updated patterns appear.
[*] All bosses have increased hp, with late-game bosses more resistant to ranged attacks.
[*] Further increased the durability of some enemies on hard mode.

Special thanks to content creators like Etsy8Nine (The Game Doctor), Mujikalou and Dracolair for their hard mode feedback.
[/list]


[h3]More Changes:[/h3] 
[list]
[*] [b]Reworked Tutorial[/b]: We've reworked it to be more intuitive and forgiving based on player feedback.
[*] [b]Localization improvements[/b] to all languages. Credit to Neon Noroshi for further refinements to eastern language translations.
[*] Extended dialog and interactions for Silex the Scavenger - dialog credit to T-Dog Extreme.
[*] Refinements to multiple existing sprites - special thanks to Rex Smeal
[*] Reworked the [b]Blood Thirsty character background perk[/b], HP restoration from bosses has been toned down, and fewer orbs can be drawn at once.
[i]Tip: You can unlock character background perks by rescuing someone from the Catacombs..[/i]
[*] Multiple UI enhancements, especially related to prompts.
[*] Considerable optimization work for better performance on older devices.
[*] Hammer animation has been reworked, and the weapon is easier to wield.
[*] And much more..
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support ❤️— it’s what makes updates like this possible ✨.

Have fun!

notes.title: Update Set 1.3
notes.content:
[i]Greetings Adventurers, 

here's some of what we've been working on in the last few months![/i]

[h2]The Game is now Steam Deck Verified[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/a27a9591b2f19ab008513036b6f50dc0ca51b3e3.png[/img]

Note: The device photo was taken over a year ago. The game runs even better on the Steam Deck now, with much more content.

[h2]New Runes[/h2]
There are currently five new runes granting passive perks to the player:

These are: Cucoon, Healing, Ice Armor, Stunning and Zapper!

For instance, Zapper briefly electrocutes nearby enemies upon defeating an opponent. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/d835925cfe9926a574bf31fc8e98c58630e244b8.png[/img]


[h2]Combat Arenas ⚔️[/h2]
Up for more challenges? Fight off waves of enemies for greater rewards!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/4f1a7c11a85b63c4f699dc8c6ffeecf862f28d4f.png[/img]

There are currently four distinct arena layouts across the first three worlds; each pitting your skills against semi-randomized waves.

[h2]Moss[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/c47e9aecfee7f52456c6728f86bff1165358dfd7.png[/img]
Lush moss and border plants now grow in the Grotto of Guidance, making the world feel even more alive.

[h2]Localization[/h2]
We've been working on improving localization and interface across all languages.

With Neon Noroshi's help, we now support Traditional Chinese, Korean, and Japanese languages.

[h2]New Publisher on PC: Indie.IO[/h2]
We've recently partnered with the experts at [b]Indie.IO[/b], after working on the game for many years solo. We look forward to polishing and sharing the game more while working alongside them.


NOTE: We are currently working with our Switch publisher: Hidden Trap to get the update to Nintendo Switch as well.

[h3]Other Changes Include:[/h3]
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/a83edb150f8e14e297e1b176e07670936af4cdd5.png[/img]
[*] If you're a returning player, you may find a gift for you at the top left of the hub.
Additionally, your XP gain is boosted by 12% for the next 10 days.
[*] New environmental interactions, such as bouncing/throwing around rocky beetle shells.
[*] The tutorial is now much more forgiving
[*] Added a sparkling guide and custom respawn animations to the tutorial 
[*] Numerous optimizations
[*] Refinements to unlock menus across all languages.
[*] Adjusted startup screen to avoid the illusion of the application loading hanging on Windows. 
[*] Fixed prerequisite text related bugs
[*] Giant Slimes will now only drop their item if substantially stunned or slain.
[*] Fixed bug with certain frozen enemies still being able to melee the player.
[*] Increased melee combat with skeletal warriors, faster paced.
[*] Added combo delay nerf to daggers
[*] Localization adjustments.
[*] Min text sizes increased for Steam Deck.
[*] Improved cross-platform saving.
[*] Much more..
[/list]


As always, your feedback is most welcome!

Have fun!

notes.title: Update Set 0.126.X - New Upgrades System & More
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers,

Here are some more recent extensions We've added to the game:

[h3]Character upgrades[/h3]
You can now purchase optional buffs to your player, including starting with additional supplies, healing between levels or entering with an additional rune power. 

These can be unlocked with resonant fragments. You can collect fragments each time you unlock gear, pets, character backgrounds or worlds with experience tokens.
 
Veteran players who want to challenge themselves further can toggle these off at any time, in exchange for a small XP bonus. We've also made the game slightly more challenging to account for the new system.

[h3]Gamepad improvements 🎮[/h3]
Players using gamepad will notice that it will now have haptic feedback on certain events. Vibrations occur on taking damage, explosive jumping or special attacks from bosses 🎮 and more.

After much research, we've also changed the default controls for new players, to a more intuitive layout (existing players can reset to the new defaults using Settings->Options->Controls menu).

[h3]Improved strike effects and animations ⚔️ [/h3]
Most weapons strikes and status effects have new and improved animations when hitting a target. 
Additionally the filters applied on taking damage have been drastically increased.

[h3]Other Changes include 🔧 [/h3]
[list]
[*] Various optimizations to increase support for low-end pcs and console devices.
[*] The hunter can now also be stunned by the bright flash of destroyed lanterns or braziers.
[*] Reworked 2nd part of tutorial to make key mechanics clearer (e.g. picking up and throwing stunend enemies).
[*] Refinements to various menus, especially those related to inventory management or unlocks.
[*] Numerous rebalancing improvements
[*] Numerous bug fixes
[*] Some surprises..
[/list]

[h3]Patch 0.126.3 (24th of June)[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where mouse position could rarely override the gamepad's weapon wheel selection.
[*] Added 12% shop cost adjustment to Runeist background.
[*] Minor display fixes to character upgrade menu,
[/list]

[h3]Patch 0.126.5 (25th of June)[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now use keys 1-4 on keyboard to filter what's shown on the weapon wheel.
[*] Fixed issue where dying while poisoned would apply the blur effect to menus.
[*] Increased speed and sound effects in unlockables related menus. Fixed scaling issue with upgrades toggle button.
[/list]

[h3]Soon to come[/h3]
[list]
[*] More build customizations options.
[*] Additional strike effects
[/list]

[i][b]Have fun![/b][/i]

notes.title: The Optimization Update + Steam Deck Experience improvements
notes.content:
[h2]Optimization in update 0.115.X[/h2]

Hi folks,

We've been testing the game on the Steam Deck and preparing the game for porting to Nintendo Switch. In the process, we found ways we could substantially optimize the game. For example, we noticed that the frame rate would flicker on certain devices when exploring a new part of the map and clearing away the fog of war, so we've been reworking the caching algorithm to run much faster.

[h2]Steam Deck related Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue with screen scaling cropping off the left side of the screen.
[*] Controller support activates automatically on Linux
[*] Weapon select wheel will not show consumables tabs when there is zero quantity left (outside of tutorial)
[*] A much smoother experience (partly from the abovementioned optimizations).
[/list]

Thank You to Flqtline and Dannz0r for sharing their experiences, screenshots, and test data for the Steam deck.


[h2]Other quality of life and balance changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed input and texture glitch in fullscreen mode on a widescreen monitor.
[*] Adjusted attack patterns of Golem and fixed bug where it could re-perform the stomp attack multiple times in succession. 
[*] Rush themes such as lava ascent, poison gas, and avalanche move slightly faster (red explosive crystals are more common during avalanches).
[*] Added additional lines of attack dialogue to Necromancer.
[*] You can now destroy flamethrower traps in Mantle's Edge with explosives.
[*] Ice Mage and Golems are now more resilient to damage.
[*] Area/run health scaling increased slightly.
[/list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: New World: Mantle's Edge 🔥 + Multiple Enhancements ⚔️
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/d20d25bb03742b44bf8892055e65a8a94a694d8c.png[/img]

Far below the crust caverns and past the thawing lake; lies a world of ritual and fire. It's a biome where supernatural and elemental creatures intermingle with ancient architecture and engineering marvels. The ancients here built shrines around a chasm to maintain balance and appease powerful beings above and below. They viewed Cold Crust Caverns as a place of preservation, with Mantle's Edge as the realm's fiery forge.


Gold is much more abundant here, but so are the perils.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/3637190b415f4a320c93ca28bd699f303a087143.png[/img]

The Edge of the Mantle Area marks the 5th biome added to our game and a milestone toward the game's Full Release in 2023.

[h2]New Enemies and Traps include[/h2]
(but are not limited to)

[list]
[*][b]Giant Golden Fists: [/b]
The ancients designed these to pulverize intruders, though, with some planning and quick thinking, you might be able to use a few to your advantage...
[*][b]Dragon Turrets[/b]
[*][b]Blaze Stars[/b]
[*][b]Gilded Serpents[/b]
[*][b]Ashen Warriors[/b]
[*][b]Fire Slimes[/b]
[*][b]+Multiple others, including some surprises...[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/1afe5b1399b4d20241a239275be0d15a1edf2f41.gif[/img]
[/list]

[h2]Sword and Dagger Combat rework:[/h2]
Slashes now use a traditionally animated arc instead of a rotating hitbox; with a much broader reach and effect. This extends to all swords and dagger weapons (except the bronze knife).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/d788f5db846c89b07d7b0d98fc352271fe14ec86.gif[/img]

[h2]New Graphical Polish:[/h2]
We've added improved unique animations to the game for multiple actions. These include 
[list]
[*]item collection
[*]objects breaking
[*]opponents getting destroyed and more...
[/list]

While reworking a sub-image algorithm we also fixed occasional render offset issues with parallax backgrounds and all cave-related terrain.


[h2]Item Modifiers:[/h2]
[list]
[*]All items found during a run have a much higher chance of receiving positive and negative modifiers that affect their utility.
[*] Items found mid-game are guaranteed to have positive traits added, with more modifiers added in late-game areas (community)
[*] New Item Modifier - Chaining:
Similar to a lighter version of the Sphere of Influence ability, what affects one opponent in the chain will affect the others. Handy for Crowd Control!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/9972fd1f3264819bd1383fad8a9107762043cdff.gif[/img]
[/list]

[h2]Other Balance Changes/Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/5dc62721f2f659e1f03f1babf103a91bcdb1b567.png[/img]
[list]
[*]The Colossal Worm boss fight has been considerably buff. It now moves/attacks more aggressively and faster, particularly as its health decreases.
[*]Most other bosses have had (more modest) buffs applied to their attacks and stats.
[*]Improved level generation in the temple by cleaning up the generation of climbable nets and moving platforms.
[*]Fixed background pedestals not being generated in the Grotto of Guidance's generation.
[*] Multiple other improvements.
[/list]


[h2]🎼🎶 New Music Track: [/h2]
For the new area
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1yvZQdB94sHxyBpq-90-c3xly_VSU3Gia/view

[h2]A note regarding price[/h2]
Even without the Steam sales factor, we've heavily discounted the game discounted during early access.
The project has been extended and polished with community feedback to evolve into quite a different game since early access started in mid-2018. You can see the list of update sets on the news page:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/841600

As such, the game will increase slightly in price this year to help us continue adding extra content to the game for you as we approach full release.


[h2]Patch 0.109.3[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved A.I. for teleportation of skeletal areas.
[*] The max level at which the XP difference is capped has increased from 27 to 32. Such was due to players potentially gaining much more XP during a run. This change will not affect the number of XP tokens you have, though it will allow you to acquire more
(unlocks like world shortcuts/backgrounds/pets/starting equipment alternatives etc.).
[*] Raised max level cap to 77
[*] Fixed transparency issue of gilded serpent eyes on Mac & Linux.
[*] Area select screen shows correct difficulty marking skulls for all areas.
[*] Fixed Bloodthirsty background, not draining health.
[/list]

Thanks for reading/playing, and have a Wonderful Week ahead!

[h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/d2d428edad7b97824be8c4f8a4810ba21d48bb0d.gif[/img] Clockwork Turrets[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/12f81d3dcddfac368d0db59ef3504bfc5563c60e.png[/img]
They're less damage-spongy and easier to hack but still pack quite a punch!

Here's what they look if you turn them friendly:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/ea5fd8f011477cd9d8fe4034873a67ff6860b299.gif[/img]

[/list]

[list]

[*] Increased variation of hazard pits.
[*] A slightly more even distribution of enemies, item drops, and traps.
[*] Various fixes to rare dead-end situations.
[*] Improved traceability.

[*]Fixed issue with rebind dodge roll mode not being saved on quitting the game.
[*]Fixed rare music silencing bug.
[*]Patched some visual changes with the blink ability.
[*]Reworked the second level of the tutorial to be more friendly and intuitive.
[*]Drastically increased chances of shotbow and orb of stunning appearing in starting gear and shop selection once unlocked.
[*]Accelerator platforms will no longer get stuck if just beneath a jump-through platform.
[*]Jumping through platforms and objects is now more consistent and less sticky.
[*]Multiple other improvements.
[/list]

[h2]Patch 0.106.18 (3rd of July 2022)[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed rare level generation bug of hazard pits eating into hand-made templates.
[*] Fixed rare bug of hazard pits being too wide to jump
[*] Fixed visual alignment issues with lava.
[*] Fixed bug where the slowing field couldn't be re-used
[*] Fixed uncommon bug of lava pit self-destructing.
[*] Fixed frost shard spell not being drawn on player's hand while being charged.

Without giving to much away, here are some development snapshots from last month, May:

We hope that you enjoy the updates and keep well![/i]

notes.title: Update Set 0.104.X + upcoming biome teaser
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Here are some of the new updates we've been working on:

[h2]New Enemies[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/53d54cfd3f7f435521f2a4b452063912ed99d179.gif[/img]
[h3]Cursed Tomes[/h3] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/e35915f1e5c0274c4636e4da2c64f042156ab1f3.gif[/img]

These books were enchanted to bring the story of intruders to an abrupt end with a variety of melee and ranged attacks.

You can find them in the Celestial Catacombs (renamed from the Celestial Temple), with a few in the far corners of Cold Crust Caverns, where they will test the skill of even the most experienced adventurers.


[h3]Possessed Crates[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/3ac729d6949b2c5da8f37d1e86609f8059f44e3f.png[/img]
Who said spirits could only inhabit vases? 
These will similarly lunge at their player after levitating to a certain height (albeit with a rush of gravity); however, due to their durability they can provide you with various uses with some lateral thinking.

[h3]..[/h3]
[h3]Oversized Mushrooms[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/aafe3a7a65b897a03151a35c2073bac343659c80.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/3faf6890688f9624510adaf70a9d177523ecc136.gif[/img]
Okay, these aren't actually opponents, 
but they have several applications when encountered in the Grotto, 
including as an jump boost pad and throw-able object.

[h2]Better Level Generation[/h2]
[h3]Hazard Pits v2[/h3]
Filled with spikes, lava, spring traps, or briars to give a bit more edge to your adventures. 
In the past these were barely noticeable, small, and prone to occasional glitches. 
We've drastically reworked them 
to grow with the terrain and become more expansive with carefully placed platforms.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/29e9daa78cf3c4832fbedc412d0e16f2cd88220a.png[/img]

[h3]Improved Level Themes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Dark levels properly dim the ambient lighting as time progresses
[*]Avalanche levels have increased speed.
[*]Flooded levels have now been given multiple enhancements and safeguards for their generation.
They can occur in the gardens rather than the catacombs, with the former being more likely.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/72cb368256758c245a149acf1d79009037f4e0ab.png[/img]
[/list]
[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*] High-level enemies can now spawn earlier on hard mode,
while futuristic opponents are less likely to appear in earlier worlds.
[*]Improved jump through platform supports.
[*]Much more.
[/list]

[h2]Additional Improvements/changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]If you have to quit the game mid-run (through the Pause menu), you will still gain the XP.
[*]The cost of all in-game items has increased (though items you've unlocked you would have obtained at a discount), added early player rewards to ease players in.
[*]Added option for changing dodge roll configurations (tapping a given button/ducking while running or a mixture of both).
[*]Nerfed orb mage projectile speed.
[*]Now, all mages and cursed tomes drop a few health orbs on defeat.
[*]Added controller/mouse prompts to all inventory hot slots.
[*]Sphere of Influencing/chaining status effects last over 3 times longer.
[*]Fixed greyscale effect on having no tokens/locked world areas.
[*]Updated Shotbow/arrow graphics.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/fd91aad2800ee3d671659f00cc2e772c54203d17.png[/img]       [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/06242deba39c8a9a2843bde1ce7a7c78e0ec71ae.png[/img]
[*]Fixed bug where forging an item would sometimes drop the item from the inventory.
[*]Added per forge cap for upgrading items. Once an item receives two modifiers from a single reforge, every forge thereafter will only give one modifier, encouraging the use of other items.
[*][b]The Celestial Temple[/b] was renamed to [b]The Celestial Catacombs[/b]. The new name more closely matches the inhabitants of the area, and there's a lore reason for this which we'll get to in a future update.
[*]Fixed bugs with the glowing eyes of skeletal snakes and phase bats.
[*]Numerous bug fixes and other balance changes.
[/list]

[*]Aura of Worlds was 20% off for Steam's Lunar New year sale (in addition to the heavy early access discount).
[/list]
[h2]New Items:[/h2]
With a new year comes new tools to play with!

[h3]Shotbow[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/1b8421e3861a56284a0b3cf812161190f5c0942f.png[/img]
This weapon trades accuracy for crowd control and a few more points against larger opponents. I.e., it fires three arrows at once!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/11c24bef8d99bd5a944f6e254e86bca42b71706f.gif[/img]


[h3]Repeater[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/a1e39f2d6e99ae2f01a2c02da0db251cb0eb591e.png[/img]
The weapon fires very rapidly in exchange for accuracy and range.
Here's introducing a crystal serpent to its recently defeated cousin...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/7feff153f3eab3ef38c6e00c7f83b81d6a26dc73.gif[/img]

[h3]Stunning Orb[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/a7517811bfc920daff2a29fd3379267be312382a.png[/img]
A spell that goes through walls knocking out opponents at a distance.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/2721a51028af35f86f28a34097678c393aaa5c8a.gif[/img]

[h3]Inventory Management Updated:[/h3]
Ever wanted to wield a shield, grapple, and crossbow simultaneously without having to press too many buttons? Now you can.

We've noticed when watching people play that many players stick to using a couple of ability items for most of the run (leaving much of the inventory to gather dust). We want to encourage more multitasking between abilities as various interactions exist between the tools simultaneously. There used to be a row of quick-swap slots, but many found these awkward to use and would often forget about them during the heat of the moment.

As such, we're replacing the quick swap row with another active offhand slot (Default bindings <R> with Mouse and <Y> on an Xbox Gamepad). We've also updated all related inventory systems; for example, smart-swapping will prioritize mobility items and non-directional powers to the new offhand slot by default.

[h3]Miscellaneous:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Buffed Recurve Bow and Chakram.
[*]Fixed parallax stuttering edge cases.
[*]Multiple other balance changes
[*]Fixed visual glitch with spear thrust attacks causing the player's hands to disconnect with the weapon.
[*]Much more...
[/list]

[b]A note regarding price[/b]
Even without the Steam sales factor, we've heavily discounted the game discounted during early access.
The game has been extended and polished with community feedback to become quite a different experience each year in early access. You can see the list of update sets on the news page:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/841600
As such, the game will increase in price later on, to help us add extra content to the game for you as we approach full release.

[b]恭禧發財! We wish you all the best for the year of the Tiger 🏮🐅![/b]

notes.title: New boss: Luminous Grand Slime, new enemies, items & more
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Here are some of the new updates we've been working on

[h1]New Boss: Grand Luminous Slime[/h1]
This one serves as an alternative boss in the Grotto of Guidance area. It might look slightly smaller than the other bosses, but don't let that fool you. It's agile, deadly, and adaptable, with six different attacks.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/c5d683fb88573ae1bfaba7b777029260a4c839c5.png[/img]
Unlike the knight, it can't block damage from the player and is closer to a more traditional boss battle focused on pattern matching, dodging, and striking. However, throwing the environment around during this fight will give you an edge.

[h1]New Enemies Include:[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/0ed0136ab4e48b8e38724d5ac6373a17e7f7dada.gif[/img]
[h3]Stone Stars:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/c5a5ad7d803fa6d8299e451f7380ca611dc4a1fb.gif[/img]


These serve as a less aggressive and easier enemy to replace Slice Stars in the first area; they mostly bounce around the stage.
It's [b]tricky[/b], but with careful positioning, you can [b]stun[/b] then grab, and throw them at high speeds to take out more powerful opponents.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/62f295cb67d133f0abf3269328834f2a44a1572c.gif[/img]
Similar methods work for utilizing their more intelligent counterparts in later areas as well.

[h3]Poison Pitchers:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/7cde20a2a3621467bbf29ddc9689858e8efe2047.gif[/img]
These pesky plants grow on the odd wall of the Gnarled Gardens, throwing spheres of poisonous pollen gas.


[h1]New Items[/h1]

notes.title: Level Generator Overhaul + Gameplay Refinements
notes.content:
Hi folks,

We hope you're doing well during these unusual times.

[h2]Level Generation[/h2]

We've been finding ways to drastically improve this through several methods. Such includes:

[list]
[*]The path to the exit branches more, further moving away from the predictable zig-zag path.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/5525753de59473318f40f1ce29df5790970d58de.png[/img]
[*]Levels have grown, with more seamless connections between segments.
[*]Rooms no longer need to be locked to grid cells, allowing for more fluid layouts.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/9938c1a02cd2e4d7eaf9c2b2a36e5dce4c67780f.png[/img]
[*]Several of the dynamic template types have had their creation patterns rewritten.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/b00ca6fd061e44edad08d46ed5b044c26ef4cb1e.png[/img]
[*]Fixed various bugs with inaccessible rooms generating the past.
[/list]

[h2]Gameplay Improvements[/h2]
Some people who are already quite familiar with roguelites/roguelikes have asked for additional challenge.
We want to accommodate this while still allowing the game to be accessible for people who are a bit more new (e.g., having an Easy mode option).

Multiple changes address such points (especially with regards to making higher difficulty modes more challenging):
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/e3c34e85c8e8cd3e9ec9d7c5dbd5e8c7e072a977.png[/img]
[list]
[*] On higher difficulty modes, player damage and defense has been reduced. This is largely done to balance out the systems of dodging, luck, critical hits, and status modifiers, which made the game significantly easier.
[*] Health potions have had their potency reduced slightly. We changed this because of how numerous they are within the game. We saw some players had too many leftovers. Keeping your supply up, and discovering other healing methods, provide more reasons to explore the new levels a bit more!
[*] You've demonstrated how powerful the Chakram could be in the right hands, so much so that it was preferable to all primary weapons. As a result, we've had to nerf its range and speed.
It's still quite an effective weapon, but the change should encourage experimentation with other weapon types.
[*] Certain hazards like lava, spikes, and a few monster attacks have had their damage increased. Such may sound brutal, but remember it can work to your advantage too.
[*] The Necromancer and Giant Worm have both been extended to be more exciting and less exploitable. For example:
[list]
[*] Players will no longer be able to freeze lock most of the fight away. 
[*]The Necromancer is not as vulnerable when healing and will be summoned with fewer crystals destroyed.
[*]The Giant Worm has undergone improvements to all its maneuvers  and will become increasingly aggressive as it takes damage.
[/list]
[*]There are some changes which make things easier, to encourage exploration more. For example:
[list]
[*] Certain environmental weaknesses have been extended (e.g., some status effects on the Giant Worm).
[*] Fewer enemies are spawned on the generation of a boss level.
[/list]
[*] Bezoar has a chance to transfer poison enemies (as well as increasing your own resistance).
[/list]

[b]A special Thanks to all the testers on the Alpha branch[/b] 

Thanks for reading/playing, and have a Wonderful Week ahead!

notes.title: The Forge & Fortune Update 🛠️🍀
notes.content:
Hi folks,

A key focus of this update is making equipment much more satisfying to loot and use.

[h2]Upgrade Forges:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/1753bd090a3ca9407164047669abc9718e88e7ad.gif[/img]
These stations provide you with a way to adds modifiers to your equipment.

You can upgrade your equipment multiple times during a run, but only once per forge. Forges allow you to upgrade 2-3 items at a time, to encourage you to experiment with more tools.

[h2]Item Modifiers:[/h2]
These change how your gear behaves: from piercing arrows to recharging shield gauntlets. 
Or occasionally freezing enemies to sending enemies flying!

Modifiers can be applied to any of your items (except consumables, regular boomerangs and powers). Feel free to experiment with over 15 of them across more than a dozen items!

[h2]Altars and Treasure Updates:[/h2]
An altar will generate several items that you'll need to choose between. 
This may be equipment items or runes you don't have yet or consumables. There are well over 40 possible items!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/685a24b3e5cb02e2042409d8d4235aa14485a213.png[/img]
In the past, most items would not spawn in-game until you had unlocked it as starter equipment. We realize this was a mistake, as it prevented players from experiencing a core part of the game until much later.
To remedy this locked items still have a chance to spawn in altars and chests, (just at 1/10th of their regular probability if locked)

To make things more interesting, equipment that you loot from the world (e.g. altars, bosses and large chests) will usually have random modifiers attached to them (not all of them positive).

[h2]New Potions:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/c7fffe35ff6a3b8bd9d84f9321a0373089f22136.png[/img][b]Potion of Luck:[/b] Increases your luck for a substantial period of time (see below)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/d9ced09edc81ce52d45abc6f12f2117e6302c857.png[/img] [b]Flask of Frost:[/b] Freezes any enemy that you attack! Just be wary of the temporary 
resistance to ice after thawing.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/WOrelW1dcdsq4DY5f9/giphy.gif[/img]


[h2]Luck[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/507cc91d786359c3f699ce449b2dd5006008f7f2.png[/img]:[/h2]

May the odds be ever in your favor! Luck increases the chance of good things happening while fighting, forging, and other activities.
It's always possible to win the game with good skill and poor luck, however, it pays to have an edge.

Some of the effects that luck has includes:
[list]
[*] Discounts at stores.
[*] Dodging an attack (despite it touching you)
[*] The chance of getting more than one positive item modifier upon upgrading.
[*] Amount of money dropped by enemies.
[*] and more...!
[/list]

Various actions in-game, such as opening all chests in a level or slaying a boss, will increase luck for a time.

[h2]Dodging and critical hits:[/h2]
There is now a chance to dodge attacks (despite them touching you) and a chance to deal much more damage to the opponent.
Factors such as luck, acrobatics, runes, and equipment modifiers all affect this.

[h2]More Graphics Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] New unlock menus
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/20a25fa448cbf1ebcc3d11a9dd797b9ce0f2fb28.png[/img]
[*] Status effects time is now display with a darkened image meter: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/db55524fddbe88132488f2b619da2ddfdbe45593.png[/img]
[i]For example:[/i]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/igJbXs5BibXbrX6QQ4/giphy.gif[/img]
Note: the crossbow here has piercing and poison element modifiers applied.
[*] Each area has it's own water colors (see image below)
[/list]


[h2]Quick Buff:[/h2]
So you told us that during an emergency, it took too long to find and quaff down the potions you needed to survive. Drawing inspiration from other games, we found that a shortcut to drink all positive potions addressed this quite nicely. No more fiddling around with the inventory grid or weapon wheel, simply hold down [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/7dcbc1867256eb180889a69ae373e7a31bf790d8.png[/img] on keyboard or gamepad by default (gamepad will default to using quick heal button on next load).

[h2]Other changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Orb mage retreats slower and projectiles can't damage you before they're launched.
[*] Easy mode XP percentage increased from 70% to 80%
[*] Fixed bug with mouse/cursor lock would crash the game.
[*] Fixed various glitches with help prompt displays.
[*] Fixed bug with skeletons getting stuck in shallow pools of water.
[*] Increased the range of most melee weapons.
[*] Bosses marginal increase in health due to the modifiers making things easier.
[*] Various improvements and fixes to the inventory menu.

Here's what the gardens and temple water look like now:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/263466b8e4c82c6f3af677c9f09a515f92c4ff57.png[/img]
[/list]


[h3]Feedback is welcome![/h3]
Especially through the forums or on [url=https://discord.gg/qN9J5f4][b]Discord[/b]:

notes.title: Update set 0.79.x: Easy mode, pets, new ability + more outfits, audio 🎵...
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32575180/1428c15e2046d0440d622e09628dadd5413c42bb.png[/img]
[h1] Introducing a new system of Pets[/h1]
[list]
[*] These companions that will follow you around as you navigate the labyrinths of death and the realms beyond.
[*]As with most systems (starting gear/worlds/character backgrounds/skins) their unlock cost is discounted during early access.
Keep an eye out for those egg collectables...
[/list]

[h1]🎼 New Audio[/h1]
Additional sound effects have been added to the grotto.

We also have a new boss 🎶 piece for the necromancer 

[h1] New skin tones and outfits[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32575180/607120b4d391597c05eeef00adaaae917a05cb4c.gif[/img]
Leading to over 27 new cosmetic combinations since the previous update set.



[h1] New Difficulty Mode[/h1]

A few players have asked for a more gradual difficulty curve.
The easy mode provides a much more forgiving game experience, whilst retaining a degree of the core challenge.

In case you're wondering what the differences are between the 3 difficulties:
[b]Easy:[/b] 
[list]
[*] Most noticeably there is no timer for the hunter's appearance, so you can take as much time as you like without having to evade it.
[*]Special pursuit level themes (lava,gas,fading lights...) move slower.
[*] Your attacks are stronger
[*] Take 12% less damage.
[*] Many enemy moves are nerfed including having slower and fewer projectiles.
[*] Health potions are more effective.
[*]Be warned though that world/boss completion achievements are disabled in this mode; XP is also earned at a 30% slower rate. 
[/list]

	
[b]Moderate:[/b] The Standard experience.
   Note that health potions have been adjusted slightly due to the addition of the previous mode.

[b]Hard 💀: [i]Designed for the masters[/i][/b]
[list]
[*] Bosses have more health and enter their enraged phases sooner.
[*] Certain enemy moves are faster and happen more frequently (e.g. skeletal warriors become much better at dodging).
[*]Enemies are more resilient to harm and will deal out more damage per attack.
[*] Starting health and recovery is smaller.
[*] Pursuit level themes (lava/pollen flood/fading light etc.) move faster.
[*] Made slightly harder as of this update.
[*] Bonuses: + 30% XP, hardest achievements and bragging rights.
[/list]


[h1]New Ability: Sphere of influence[/h1]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/Jmfyi6yyDFExgYcl7X/giphy.gif[/img]
This is a handy spell that knits the life energy of creatures together, allowing you to chain up opponents.

Injuring one opponent in the chain, injures them all. Setting one on fire also spreads the light through the connected...
Can be particularly powerful against groups of enemies or for hitting more elusive monsters with the right planning.
	

	
[h1][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32575180/7e90579b2864c47ee1e72d95c1d165280c35d68c.png[/img] GUI and other graphics[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added shield gauntlet collapsed state; actively drawn on character.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32575180/ffde40b98c88374dfdac3bb195194d53e005d636.png[/img]
[*] New menu for purchasing pets.
[*] Better scaling of existing menu elements for wide screen.
[*] Notification icons now appear when a new item/character background/pet becomes available.
[*] Fixed up the control rebind menu so it is fully compatible with the Xbox controller.
[*] Additional background set pieces including parallax statues for the grotto and chains for the temple.
[*] Updated credits screen.
[/list]

[h1]Narrative[/h1]
We added an intro transition screen for a bit of exposition.
Some environmental art has also been added to convey more of the setting 
It's no substitute for an epic story, but it does set things up for the narrative we have planned for the game...

	
[h1]Steam stats:[/h1]
[list]
[*]  Fixed bug with Ghost Lover achievement and stats not unlocking properly. Sorry about that, if you've met the pre-requisites it should now auto-unlock the next time you play.
[*] Added additional Steam stats regarding unlockables. These will go to automatically unlocking some new achievements in the future...
[/list]

	 
[h1]Optimization[/h1]
[list]
[*] Reduced the number of draw calls and render textures created across the entire game.
[*] Render textures are cached more instead of creating new ones to save on memory and performance.
[*] Fixed Rare OpenGL memory issue which randomly skipped rendering the lighting layer for a chunk.
[/list]
	

[h1]Bug fixes and rebalancing [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32575180/4a3f6e3403bfddda8bb82b26cbab89baa20f7851.png[/img][/h1]
[list]
[*] Behavior for grapple release adjusted to be more intuitive on controller.
[*] You can stand on fallen stalactites now.
[*] Nerfed orb mage pre-hard difficulty. It will no longer jet away from you as fast to dish out pain.
[*] Skeletal soldiers will roll away from you at close range.
[*] Crystal eye telegraphs where it's going to fire.
[*] Repeater dart trap have been slowed slightly
[*] Firebrands/embers are no longer acting like straphnel.
[*] Fixed issue with notification text not appearing 
[*] Multiple other tweaks 
[*] Additional time before the hunter's summoning is given on the higher levels.
[*] Progress Menu now shows character backgrounds and pet unlocks at the end of each run (not just equipment items).
[/list]

[H1]Patch 0.79.18[/H1]
[b]15th July[/b]
[list]
[*]Certain pets now glow.
[*]Fixed uncommon generation glitch where 1 block waterfalls could spawn.
[*]Updated Steam stats: added world unlocks, tied unlocked_equipment stat to [i]Shining Collector achievement[/i] 
[/list]

[H1]Patch 0.79.20[/H1]
[b]20th July[/b]
[list]
[*] Pets cloak along with their owner.
[*] Fixed bug where steam stat for unlocked_equipment didn't get uploaded until game was closed.
[*] Added new version of level end stinger for completing a boss level.
[*] Items in quick slots are now much more visible.
[*] Added Advanced Graphics Options menu.
[*] Changed damage resistance of Easy mode from 12% -> 15%
[*] Added an option to change how quick slots are displayed (see advanced graphics options menu)
[/list]

[H1]Patch 0.79.21.5[/H1]
[list]
[*]Added Legacy Tile Render option (for the rare case of older drivers running out of OpenGL memory). 
Go to Graphics->Options->Advanced->Tile Renderer on starting the game.
[*]Added a couple more background art objects to the temple.
[*]Health potions and vampirism orbs now heal you 8% and 20% more  respectively on Easy mode.
[/list]

[H1]Patch 0.79.22.5 [/H1]
[b]11th August[/b]
Changed the default tile renderer back to legacy for any new players.

This was in light of a windows 10 update throttling the amount of memory available to OpenGL on certain drivers. This lead to a rare Out of Memory exception on a few machines (crash/white fog)
steamcommunity.com/app/841600/discussions/0/1840188800808448613/

If your driver is updated to have enough memory you can change this in 
Graphics->Options->Advanced->Tile renderer.

[H1]Patch 0.79.23[/H1]
[list]
[*] Added options to invert X/Y axis on controller right analog stick.
As well as an option to swap them. This could give better support for PS4 controller.
[*] Added more clarity to grotto foreground tiles.
[/list]

We've been working on much more for the next update set in the background...



[b]Have fun![/b]

notes.title: Update set 0.75.x: Character backgrounds, polish & more...
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32575180/7e9a43a64ba0ea21edadadcf0699036520fdac3c.png[/img]

With this new system comes 9 different player trait/passive ability sets which allow for further customization of play-style.

These range from increased defence to gaining double jump & infinite wall vault.

Beware that the perks they offer are not without trade-offs. 
One of our favorite is bloodthirsty which will gradually drain your health but allow you to heal from injured enemies (with a number of other augments to your damage).  


[h1]Achievements[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32575180/b03d116c2e1749bb54eeb0b87a0045f6f2aff85d.png[/img]
[list]
[*]5 New achievements
[*]Redesigns of 2 previous achievements.
[*]Steam stat integration.
[*]Tracking of multiple new player metrics behind the scenes for future unlocks. 
[/list]

[h1]Player Damage Overhaul[/h1]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/9LXR5PBkdYOYxrARP5/giphy.gif[/img]
Getting hit carries more impact and taking heavy damage (particularly from ranged, melee or explosions) can stun you for a split second. 

This makes running through encounters a fair bit more challenging...

[h1]Graphics & Options[/h1]
[list]
[*] Much better widescreen support.
E.g.
[list]
[*] Shadow sight target markers scale properly.
[*] Multiple menu/hud elements reworked to resize with larger resolutions. 
[/list]
[*] New graphics for character background sets and unlockable items menus.
[*] Mouse locking now available (See Options->Other).
[*] Cleaned up player HUD of many extraneous details.
[/list]  



[h1]Other Key Changes[/h1]
[list]
  [*] Level generation for the Grotto is much more varied.
  [*] New Sound effects for picking up items.
  [*] Skeletal warriors move more predictably when fighting.
  [*] Multiple medium and high tier enemies have a much greater chance of dropping coins or other items.
  [*] Now all the bosses have enraged phases. For example the bronze knight now becomes considerable faster and more aggressive below a certain HP.
  [*] Damage and knockback adjusted to take into account how player damage has been reworked. Health potions also heal for a little extra.
  [*] Made dodge rolling faster and longer range.
  [*] Multiple other balancing changes.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32575180/5dc62721f2f659e1f03f1babf103a91bcdb1b567.png[/img]
[list]
  [*] Fixed rare issue of 2 textures disappearing from the multi-thread rendering
  [*] Disabled buttons are now faded out.
  [*] Fixed bugs with enduring and resourceful achievements triggering without meeting the conditions.
  [*] You can no longer pick up and carry temporal fields.
  [*] Numerous title and description texts fixed.
  [*] Multiple other.
[/list]


[h1]***Update 0.75.7 (24th February)***[/h1]
[list]
[*] Updated all status/collectable/helper prompt text in game to scale with the resolution (previously they were blitted onto a render texture which was scaled); though testers have told us they've found this much smoother.
[*]Various tweaks including:
[list]
[*] Most enemies in the grotto have lower health on normal difficulty.
[*] Dodge rolling works against skeletons on hard mode.
[*] updated a couple of icons:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32575180/60f11b1782763bfbfc294500e888ee9b4b164e9c.png[/img] 
[*] Aquatic enemy pools are a bit less crowded.
[*] Fixed mouse detection for weapon wheel at different resolutions.
[/list]


[/list]

[h1]***Patch 0.75.10 (3rd March)***[/h1]
[list]
[*] Adjusted enemy health scaling for temple and grotto enemies.
[*] Aquatic pools have less enemies during pursuing toxic pollen.
[*] Pursuing toxic pollen is slightly slower on moderate difficulty.
[*] Ceiling lickers retract with their catch more slowly.
[*] Fixed glitch with Chakram unlock.
[*] Added more knockback resistance when the player is hit under water.
[*] Several other adjustments.
[/list]

[i]If you have any feedback or suggestions; please let us know in the forum or comments![/i]



[b]Enjoy :D![/b]

notes.title: Permanent Progression Overhaul - Update 0.69
notes.content:
New items, sound effects, rewards for earlier players and an entirely new set of unlockable goods.

[h1]New weapons / abilities[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32575180/30f50b3a99838c1962e6796b40b822c79f10018b.png[/img]  [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32575180/4c30305e2561b3f2ccb6e3fcf4896906291ad49d.png[/img]  [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32575180/f57efd7a098e1ce2c14a9cfc02e48ae41264ffa7.png[/img] 

Hammers, Chakrams, Temporal field...

[h1]New XP system[/h1]
[list]
[*]NOTE: This is done in a way that does not compromise on challenge; but allows you to access strategic options and bonuses. You can read about the rationale in the first post here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/841600/discussions/0/1739964947814298396/

        [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32575180/64d6cdba898dac10dcea46e8cb17350f89f40942.png[/img]
[*][b]Earlier players[/b] will also be rewarded a large starting bonus; based on what's been achieved so far. What you've unlocked stays unlocked in the future.
[*] Levelling up grants tokens which can be spent on various unlockable items/world shotcuts etc.
[/list]

[h1]Unlockables include:[/h1]
[list]
[*] 7 relating to weapons and abilities.
[*] Rerolling starter equipment.
[*] Two world shortcuts will be free if you unlocked them earlier (otherwise they cost 5 tokens each)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32575180/9a0427c75e64bbe57a8dd1e5a00aab492c37b9b9.gif[/img]
[/list]

[h1]Menu Stuff[/h1]

[list]
[*] Multiple menus reprogrammed to work much better with widescreen and higher resolutions.
[*] Added Progression Menu.

[*] New graphics for all purchase/equipment related menus.
[*] Added Unlockables Menu.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32575180/ffb70b42a7b505adbc9548ec8cbadf1ecfb5722f.png[/img]
[b]NOTE:[/b] costs may be discounted slightly for this update.
[/list]

[h1]Tweaks to player physics[/h1]
[list]
[*]Reach maximum speed faster; but max sprint speed is marginally lower (<10%) for better control.
[*]Made grapple swinging more instantaneous.
[/list]

[h1]Animation refinements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Several new animations including:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32575180/0f6abda309dbee409436ae9da2c1a522990006b0.gif[/img]
[*]Spear slashes now have a weapon trail.
[*]Fixes to the frames of humanoid entities holding weapons when landing.
[/list]

[h1]Bug fixes and optimizations[/h1]
[list]
[*]Light colors of melee weapons now reflect their materials more closely (with crystal yielding more light).
[*]Code optimizations to collision checking.
[*]Fixed Credits menu cropped at higher resolutions.
[*]Fixed Choose equipment menu breaking when reopening after changing resolutions.
[*]Considerably reduced time writing to output files (e.g. saving progression and logging).
[*]Several others.
[/list]

Looking forward to hearing what you think :)

notes.content:
Hi folks,

We've been listening to your feedback and suggestions over the past two weeks and have been updating the game accordingly :)

[h1]Here's what's changed...[/h1]

    [list][*] Sharpness
    [*] Shadow

    [*] Double-Jump.

[*] [i]You can now interrupt dodge rolling half way; with a jump.[/i]

[list]

    [*] No more out of boomerang prompts while waiting for the last one thrown to return.

    [*] No gap at base of rising lava texture
    [*] Fixed ugly texture gaps on hud bars; when swapping from a higher resolution back to native (1066x600) res.

  [*] Jellyfish have a telegraph animation.
  [*] Fewer enemies deal contact damage; and those that do (e.g. giant slimes) have revised rules including an added delay before applying that attack.
  [*] Mages are smarter and will avoid teleporting into obvious traps like lava or spears.  
[/list]
  
[*][b]Sound/graphics[/b]:
[list]
 [*] Improved support for higher resolutions. Title animations and coin prompt animations now scale properly.
 [*] Wall slide sound effect.
 [*] Engine support for looped sound.
 [*] Red "x" appears on items which are out of supplies/charges"
[/list]
[*] Numerous other tweaks and balance changes...

[/list]
